name: WeSmart Database
description: The database of the WeSmart platform: organisations, energy sharing projects, their participants with their place, metering point and devices, the quarter-hour readings of those points and the mandates under which the operators' hubs were read. Read, never written, by @nexgen-os/wesmart-database, which imports it into a Nexgen OS installation run for the same organisations.
license: The data of WeSmart's customers, processed by WeSmart on their behalf; not redistributable
